title: Text recognition (OCR)
intro: Choose one self-hosted OCR service for the shared project. Documents are sent only to the configured destination. Business fields are extracted by fixed rules and must be reviewed.
unconfigured: OCR is disabled or no service is configured.
docling: Docling Serve — text, layout and tables
keyHelp: Keys are encrypted server-side using OCR_SETTINGS_KEY. After changing provider or URL, replace or delete the key. Existing keys are never displayed.
unrestrictedWarning: All HTTP(S) destinations are allowed, including internal services. There is no network allowlist or SSRF protection. Only trusted admins should configure this address.
httpWarning: HTTP is not encrypted: documents and any API key are transmitted in plaintext. Prefer HTTPS on untrusted or public networks.
formats: Supported input: PDF, PNG, JPEG, TIFF and BMP.
noSearchablePdf: Searchable PDF output is not supported.
limits: Maximum 25 MiB, 10 PDF pages, 180 seconds. No automatic fallback. OCR text and tables are not stored. Field extraction currently uses German-focused rules, independently of the recognition language.
doclingHelp: Requires self-hosted Docling Serve 1.38.1 with local model assets and remote services disabled. The Python library alone is not an HTTP service.
testSuccess: The synthetic test image was successfully read. Draft settings were not saved.
resetConfirm: Delete saved OCR settings and API key? OCR_URL will apply again if configured.
invalidUrl: Enter an absolute HTTP(S) base URL without credentials, query parameters or a fragment.
invalidSettings: OCR configuration is invalid. Check the provider, language and service URL, or reset to environment configuration.
secretKey: OCR_SETTINGS_KEY is missing, invalid, or cannot decrypt the stored API key. Restore the original 64-character hexadecimal key, or replace/delete the stored API key.
secretMissing: Enter a non-empty API key without line breaks.
secretDestination: The stored key belongs to a different provider or URL. Explicitly replace or delete it.
unreadable: The document could not be read.
unsupported: Unsupported document format or mismatched file contents. Use PDF, PNG, JPEG, TIFF or BMP.
tooManyPages: The PDF exceeds 10 pages. Split it before recognition.
invalidPdf: The PDF is unreadable, corrupt or encrypted.
busy: OCR is busy. Please try again later.
timeout: Text recognition exceeded the time limit.
unreachable: The OCR service could not be reached.
authentication: The OCR service rejected the API key.
redirect: The OCR service returned a redirect. Configure its final base URL instead.
providerFailure: The OCR service could not process the document.
invalidResponse: The OCR service returned an incompatible or invalid response.
responseTooLarge: The OCR response exceeded the 8 MiB response limit.
partial: Recognition was incomplete. No partial result was applied.
languageUnsupported: This Tesseract service cannot apply the selected language. Update the companion container.
legacyLanguage: The legacy Tesseract service uses its own OCR_LANG default; the selected language cannot be verified. Update the companion container for per-request language selection.
testFailed: The service responded, but the expected text was not recognized in the test image.
